title: Payment Plan Status of a Patient Invoices & Statements Invoice
content:
A Patient Invoices & Statements invoice joins a payment plan only when its billing class can be enrolled in a payment plan and the plan was accepted by the patient under the rules of Patient Payment Plans.

## While on the plan

- The invoice's status is payment plan, and the record names the plan carrying it.
- Statements stop where the billing class's setting for stopping statements on a payment plan is Yes.
- Installments are booked on the plan, not on the invoice.

## When the plan ends

| How the plan ends | Effect on the invoice |
|---|---|
| The balance is paid off through the plan | The invoice is paid |
| The plan is cancelled or defaults | The plan's remaining share of the invoice returns to the invoice, the invoice is open again, and the statement cycle resumes at the next unused position |

## Joining a plan in combination

| Class can be enrolled in a payment plan | Plan accepted by the patient under the payment-plan rules | Invoice joins the plan |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | any | No |

## Illustration (hypothetical invoice)

An invoice received its first statement and then joined a plan accepted by the patient. The plan later defaults with 140.00 of this invoice's share still unpaid. The 140.00 returns to the invoice, the invoice is open again, and its next statement is the second statement, the first unused position in its cycle.
